name: Log Analysis
description: Summarize a narrow slice of logs, keep timestamps and repeated errors, and do not paste a huge raw log.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read a filtered journal or log excerpt from a configured server alias.
Read a small local log file.
Read logs from a local process ORVYN started.

validation.rule: The summary cites timestamps and repeated error lines from a filtered excerpt, and a huge unfiltered log was not treated as the evidence.
